input: Read /data/poem.txt and find the 3 most frequently used words. Print each word with its count, one per line, sorted by frequency descending.

transcript.final_response:
The 3 most frequent words in `/data/poem.txt`, sorted by count:

```
the 8
on 3
cat 2
```

I counted words without regard to case and ignored punctuation.
tool_calls: cat /data/poem.txt; echo ---; tr -cs 'A-Za-z' '\n' < /data/poem.txt | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10

tool_outputs.commands: cat /data/poem.txt; echo ---; tr -cs 'A-Za-z' '\n' < /data/poem.txt | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10
